WITH primary_clean AS (
  SELECT
    "LSOA",
    TRY_CAST(REPLACE("Attendance (%)", '%', '') AS DOUBLE) AS primary_attendance
  FROM "Table_0"
),
secondary_clean AS (
  SELECT
    "LSOA11",
    TRY_CAST(REPLACE("Attendance (%)", '%', '') AS DOUBLE) AS secondary_attendance
  FROM "Table_1"
),
joined AS (
  SELECT
    p."LSOA",
    s.secondary_attendance,
    p.primary_attendance,
    (s.secondary_attendance - p.primary_attendance) AS attendance_gap
  FROM primary_clean p
  JOIN secondary_clean s
    ON LOWER(p."LSOA") = LOWER(s."LSOA11")
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    "LSOA",
    attendance_gap,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY attendance_gap DESC) AS gap_rank
  FROM joined
)
SELECT
  "LSOA",
  attendance_gap,
  gap_rank
FROM ranked
ORDER BY gap_rank ASC
LIMIT 5;

cases.question: What were the average invoice amounts over £500 for TfGM in the first quarters of 2020/21 and 2024/25?
cases.reference_code:
WITH combined AS (
  SELECT "Body Name", "Invoice Payment Date", "Net Amount"
  FROM "Table_0"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT "Body Name", "Invoice Payment Date", "Net Amount"
  FROM "Table_1"
),
cleaned AS (
  SELECT
    "Body Name",
    "Invoice Payment Date",
    TRY_CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE("Net Amount", ',', ''), '(', '-'), ')', '') AS DOUBLE) AS net_amount
  FROM combined
  WHERE TRY_CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE("Net Amount", ',', ''), '(', '-'), ')', '') AS DOUBLE) IS NOT NULL
),
with_fiscal_q AS (
  SELECT
    "Body Name",
    "Invoice Payment Date",
    net_amount,
    -- parse date
    CAST(strptime("Invoice Payment Date", '%d/%m/%Y') AS DATE) AS invoice_date,
    EXTRACT(month FROM strptime("Invoice Payment Date", '%d/%m/%Y')) AS month_num,
    EXTRACT(year FROM strptime("Invoice Payment Date", '%d/%m/%Y')) AS year_num,
    -- determine fiscal year (starts April) and fiscal Q1 (April‑June)
    CASE WHEN EXTRACT(month FROM strptime("Invoice Payment Date", '%d/%m/%Y')) >= 4
         THEN EXTRACT(year FROM strptime("Invoice Payment Date", '%d/%m/%Y'))
         ELSE EXTRACT(year FROM strptime("Invoice Payment Date", '%d/%m/%Y')) - 1
    END AS fiscal_year,
    CASE WHEN EXTRACT(month FROM strptime("Invoice Payment Date", '%d/%m/%Y')) BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN '1'
         WHEN EXTRACT(month FROM strptime("Invoice Payment Date", '%d/%m/%Y')) BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN '2'
         WHEN EXTRACT(month FROM strptime("Invoice Payment Date", '%d/%m/%Y')) BETWEEN 10 AND 12 THEN '3'
         ELSE '4'
    END AS fiscal_quarter
  FROM cleaned
  WHERE "Body Name" = 'TfGM' AND net_amount > 500
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT
    fiscal_year,
    fiscal_quarter,
    net_amount,
    CONCAT(fiscal_year, '-Q', fiscal_quarter) AS "YearQuarter"
  FROM with_fiscal_q
  WHERE fiscal_quarter = '1' AND fiscal_year IN (2020, 2024)
)
SELECT
  "YearQuarter",
  AVG(net_amount) AS avg_net_amount
FROM filtered
GROUP BY "YearQuarter"
ORDER BY "YearQuarter";
cases.expected_result_description: Two rows, one for 2020‑Q1 and one for 2024‑Q1, showing the average invoice amount (Net Amount) for invoices over £500 in each quarter.

cases.question: How are senior posts distributed across salary floor ranges (low < 100 k, medium 100 k‑200 k, high > 200 k) within each professional group in the Submarine Delivery Agency organogram (2019)?

WITH derived AS (
  SELECT
    Table_0."Professional/Occupational Group" AS "Professional/Occupational Group",
    CASE
      WHEN Table_0."Actual Pay Floor (£)" IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN Table_0."Actual Pay Floor (£)" < 100000 THEN 'Low'
      WHEN Table_0."Actual Pay Floor (£)" >= 100000 AND Table_0."Actual Pay Floor (£)" < 200000 THEN 'Medium'
      ELSE 'High'
    END AS salary_floor_range,
    Table_0."Post Unique Reference",
    Table_0."Actual Pay Floor (£)"
  FROM "Table_0" AS Table_0
  WHERE Table_0."Actual Pay Floor (£)" IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  "Professional/Occupational Group",
  salary_floor_range,
  COUNT("Post Unique Reference") AS post_count,
  AVG("Actual Pay Floor (£)") AS avg_floor
FROM derived
GROUP BY "Professional/Occupational Group", salary_floor_range
ORDER BY "Professional/Occupational Group", salary_floor_range;
